context: A mom helps her young son sort out trickier feelings
purpose: Teach: 抱か/疑っ/なにやら/至ら/気がつく/引き出す/種々/大人気

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ翔、さっきからなにやら浮かない顔してるね。何かあった?
lines.en: Hey Sho, you've had a troubled look for a while now. Did something happen?
lines.style: Warm maternal voice, soft and gently probing

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…ケンくんがぼくのこと疑ってるみたいで、なんかモヤモヤする。
lines.en: Yeah... Ken-kun seems to be doubting me, and it feels stuck inside.
lines.style: Small child voice, hesitant and a little sad

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか。ママもね、お友だちに不安を抱かせちゃったこと、昔いっぱいあったよ。
lines.en: I see. Mom also made friends feel uneasy lots of times back in the day.
lines.style: Gentle reassuring tone, sharing softly to invite trust

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママでも?でもケンくん、クラスで大人気だから、ぼくの話なんて聞いてくれないよ。
lines.en: Even you, Mom? But Ken-kun is super popular in class, so he won't listen to me.
lines.style: Childlike disbelief, voice rising with frustration

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そういう時ってね、ふと気がつくと、自分の至らなかったとこばっかり考えちゃうよね。
lines.en: At times like that, before you know it, you end up only thinking about what you fell short on.
lines.style: Soft empathetic delivery, slow and understanding

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…ぼくがわるかったのかなって、ずっと考えちゃう。
lines.en: Yeah... I keep wondering if maybe I was the one in the wrong.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerable child voice, almost whispering

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあさ、紙とクレヨン引き出すから、気持ちをお絵描きで教えてくれる?
lines.en: Then how about I pull out some paper and crayons, and you tell me your feelings through a drawing?
lines.style: Soothing maternal invitation, patient and encouraging

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…かいてみる。ほんとはね、種々あるけど、しんじてもらえないのがいちばんかなしい。
lines.en: Okay... I'll try. Honestly, there are all sorts of things, but not being believed is what makes me saddest.
lines.style: Tiny breaking voice, a small honest confession
